name: Eschershausen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Eschershausen (a yellow lion above a letter E on red).
history: Municipal flag of Eschershausen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Eschershausen arms — lion and letter E on red
